description: Data moves. You need to see where, how, and why. Sankey Diagrams for Power BI show flows money, users, materials, and more without confusion. You spot drop-offs, track conversions, and map processes with clarity. No code. No clutter. See the flow. Find the fix. Make better choices. What You Get with Sankey Diagram for Power BI by ChartExpo No-Code Setup Build detailed Sankey Charts right inside Power BI. No scripts. No formulas. Live Data Updates Flows change as your Power BI data updates. No need to refresh or re-import. Full Customization Change colors, shapes, text, and layout. Make the diagram match your needs. Multi-Level Visualization Show up to 15 steps in one flow, perfect for complex processes. Visual Export Supported Export the Sankey diagram directly from Power BI for sharing and reporting. Secure Data Handling All work happens inside Power BI. Your data never leaves. Problems Solved, Fast Can’t find where sales drop? Map the full sales journey. See where leads stall or bounce. Where does your budget leak? Visualize budget flow, and spot overspending areas. Lost in spreadsheets? Replace endless rows with clear flow diagrams. Need fast insights? Build, adjust, and share Sankey Diagrams in minutes. Use Cases That Matter Finance Teams Cash flow chart, funds flow diagram, expense report template, profit and loss statements.
